QuestInfo.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 3
QuestInfo.2: E is the hotkey for opening the Equipment Window. You can take off what you're wearing by double-clicking on the item in the Equipment Window.

0.0: My questions aren't that hard because I let you keep trying until you get them right. Nice of me, huh? Tell me when you're ready for the 3rd question.

1.0:
What do you press to open up your equipment inventory? 

#L0##b E#l
#L1# S#l
#L2# I#k#l
1.1: That's right! To check out what you have equipped, just press E.

0.1: S is to check out the skill book and your skill points. Please remember that.
0.2: I is to check out your item inventory.
